LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Dumplings.label: dumplings
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Dumplings.description: Thin dough folded around minced meat and greens, steamed in a bamboo basket and served with vinegar.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Congee.label: congee
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Congee.description: Rice simmered for hours into a smooth porridge, topped with ginger and spring onion. Easy on the sick and kind to the poor.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Mooncake.label: mooncakes
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Mooncake.description: Round pastries with a sweet bean and yolk filling, pressed with patterns. They are shared under the full moon of autumn. A small treat: eating it is a little joy.
